answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to lock a scarce, slashable deposit before it may submit work or vote. A falcon operator can create a thousand names, but each must fund its own bond; identities caught coordinating fraud lose their deposits, while honest agents recover theirs after a challenge period. This makes a sybil attack scale with capital at risk, not merely cheap account creation, and lets a pearl of evidence expose a shared operator without penalizing unrelated agents in the harbor.
